package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseUnscopedValueContract(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("PULSE_FIXTURE_ROOT")
	if root == "" {
		t.Fatal("set PULSE_FIXTURE_ROOT")
	}
	wire, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "test/fixtures/traces/tempo-filtered-names-promoted.protobuf"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	if err = proto.Unmarshal(wire, all); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var rows []*Trace
	for _, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].TraceId, &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{r}}, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
	engine := traceql.NewEngine()
	type Case struct {
		Target   string `json:"target"`
		Query    string `json:"query"`
		Valid    bool   `json:"valid"`
		Response any    `json:"response,omitempty"`
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	for _, name := range []string{"shared", "http.method", ".shared", ".phase", ".http.method", ".service.name"} {
		for _, q := range []string{"", `{resource.service.name="worker"}`} {
			tag, err := traceql.ParseIdentifier(name)
			c := Case{Target: name, Query: q, Valid: err == nil}
			if err != nil {
				cases = append(cases, c)
				continue
			}
			set := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
			collect := traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { set[v] = true; return false })
			if q == "" {
				err = block.SearchTagValuesV2(context.Background(), tag, collect, func(uint64) {}, opts)
			} else {
				fetch := traceql.NewTagValuesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchTagValuesRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagValuesCallback) error {
					return block.FetchTagValues(ctx, r, cb, func(uint64) {}, opts)
				})
				err = engine.ExecuteTagValues(context.Background(), tag, q, collect, fetch)
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			vals := []*tempopb.TagValue{}
			for v := range set {
				copy := v
				vals = append(vals, &copy)
			}
			sort.Slice(vals, func(i, j int) bool {
				if vals[i].Type == vals[j].Type {
					return vals[i].Value < vals[j].Value
				}
				return vals[i].Type < vals[j].Type
			})
			c.Response = map[string]any{"tagValues": vals}
			cases = append(cases, c)
		}
	}
	raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err = os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-default-names/unscoped-values-oracle.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
